setting.help: Enable to Include historical scrap quantities while calculating real demand. Scrap quantities will be reflected in demand calculations.
Enable to Include subcontracting BOMs, subcontracting order history, component consumption, and subcontracting lead times while calculating real demand and replenishment recommendations.
Enable to Include historical scrap quantities in orderpoint calculations. Scrap quantities will be considered when calculating reorder quantities based on the selected scrap configuration.

Enable to Include subcontracting BOMs, subcontracting order history, and subcontracting lead times while calculating reordering rules. Products with a subcontracting replenishment strategy will be considered during orderpoint generation and replenishment recommendations.
Select whether lead time should be based on subcontractor lead time, actual subcontract history receipt, or static days.
Method for Maximum Lead Days calculation: Actual Maximum Lead Time or Average + Extra Time.
setting.invisible: not use_subcontracting_for_orderpoint or subcontract_lead_calc_base_on not in ['vendor_lead_time', 'real_time']

setting.help: Extra Percentage for Maximum Lead time of subcontract.
setting.invisible: not use_subcontracting_for_orderpoint or subcontract_lead_calc_base_on not in ['vendor_lead_time', 'real_time'] or subcontract_max_lead_days_calc_method != 'avg_extra_percentage'
